name: camera-colour
title: Camera: colour
description: Average brightness and colour opponents of a camera picture.

source.detail: an RGB picture, resized to 16×16, values 0..1

outputs.name: blue_yellow
outputs.how: mean blue minus the mean of red and green

name: camera-motion
title: Camera: motion
description: How much changed since the last picture, and which way the change moved.

source.detail: an RGB picture, resized to 16×16, values 0..1

outputs.name: motion
outputs.how: mean absolute difference from the previous picture

outputs.name: motion_dx
outputs.how: horizontal shift of the changed area's centre

outputs.name: motion_dy
outputs.how: vertical shift of the changed area's centre

name: microphone-spectrum
title: Microphone: spectrum
description: Loudness and how the sound's energy is shared between low, mid and high bands.

source.detail: a block of 2048 samples at 8 kHz

outputs.name: loudness
outputs.how: root mean square of the samples

name: microphone-rhythm
title: Microphone: rhythm
description: Onsets and slow pulsing of the sound's envelope.

source.detail: a block of 2048 samples at 8 kHz

outputs.name: onsets
outputs.how: how many times the envelope jumps up

outputs.name: pulsing
outputs.how: strength of the envelope's 2–8 Hz modulation

name: keyboard-mouse
title: Keyboard and mouse
description: Key presses and mouse travel in the moment.

source.detail: key-down events and pointer movement since the last moment

name: accelerometer
title: Accelerometer
use_case: A phone or a robot that is carried
description: How strongly and how jerkily the body moves, and how it is tilted.

source.detail: x, y, z acceleration, 50 samples per moment (150 numbers)

outputs.name: shake
outputs.how: standard deviation of the acceleration magnitude

outputs.name: jerk
outputs.how: mean absolute change of the magnitude

outputs.name: steps
outputs.how: peaks per second of the magnitude

name: light-sensor
title: Ambient light sensor
description: The light level and how fast it changes.

name: location
title: Location (GPS)
description: Speed, turning and how far from the usual place.

outputs.name: speed
outputs.how: distance from the last fix per second

outputs.name: away
outputs.how: distance from the running average position

name: heart
title: Heart (wearable)
description: Heart rate and its variability from a wearable's beat-to-beat intervals.

source.detail: the last 10 beat-to-beat intervals in milliseconds

outputs.name: variability
outputs.how: root mean square of successive differences

outputs.name: change
outputs.how: rate minus the rate a minute ago

name: weather
title: Weather service
description: Outdoor weather from a weather service, refreshed now and then.

source.detail: temperature °C, pressure hPa, humidity %, wind m/s, rain mm/h

name: calendar
title: Calendar
use_case: The rhythm of a working day
description: How the person's day is filled, from their calendar.

source.detail: start and end times of today's events

name: network
title: Network traffic
description: How much the machine talks to the network.

source.detail: bytes in, bytes out, open connections since the last moment

outputs.name: burstiness
outputs.how: bytes this moment against the minute's mean

name: text-stream
title: Text stream
description: Clockwork measures of incoming text: never its meaning.

source.detail: the messages that arrived in the moment

outputs.name: questions
outputs.how: share of messages with a question mark

outputs.name: shouting
outputs.how: share of capital letters and exclamation marks

name: market
title: Market price feed
description: Change and restlessness of a price series.

outputs.name: change
outputs.how: relative change since the last moment

outputs.name: volatility
outputs.how: standard deviation of the last 20 changes

name: thermostat
title: Smart-home thermostat
description: Indoor temperature and heating from a home's thermostat.

source.detail: indoor temperature, target temperature, heating on or off

name: blank
title: Blank
description: Start from nothing: name it, say where its information comes from, list its outputs.
